DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT TOP 1 @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY =FULLDATE
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
WHERE FULLDATE < @DATEPROCESSED
    AND BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG='Y'
    AND FULLDATE=DATEADD(DAY,1,PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY)
ORDER BY FULLDATE DESC;

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BAL_BDATE AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BAL_BDATE = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY;

    GAM.SSA_PLAN_ID AS SSA_PLAN_ID,

    GAM.LAST6_ACC_NUM AS GAM_LAST6_ACC_NUM,

    RIGHT(LEFT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 9), 3) AS GAM_SOURCE_CODE,
    GAM.FILE_NAME AS GAM_FILE_NAME,
    GAM.INSERT_DTTM AS GAM_INSERT_DTTM,
    LEFT(RIGHT(GAM.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS GAM_BUSINESS_DATE,

    ------EAB------
    EAB.ACID AS EAB_ACID,
    EAB.EOD_DATE AS EOD_DATE,
    EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL AS TRAN_DATE_BAL,
    EAB.TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN AS TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN,
    EAB.VALUE_DATE_BAL AS VALUE_DATE_BAL,
    EAB.VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN AS VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN,
    EAB.END_EOD_DATE AS END_EOD_DATE,
    EAB.LCHG_USER_ID AS EAB_LCHG_USER_ID,
    EAB.LCHG_TIME AS EAB_LCHG_TIME,
    EAB.RCRE_USER_ID AS EAB_RCRE_USER_ID,
    EAB.RCRE_TIME AS EAB_RCRE_TIME,
    EAB.TS_CNT AS EAB_TS_CNT,
    EAB.EAB_CRNCY_CODE AS EAB_CRNCY_CODE,
    EAB.BANK_ID AS EAB_BANK_ID,
    LEFT(EAB.FILE_NAME, 5) AS EAB_BNK_CODE,
    RIGHT(LEFT(EAB.FILE_NAME, 9), 3) AS EAB_SOURCE_CODE,
    EAB.FILE_NAME AS EAB_FILE_NAME,
    EAB.INSERT_DTTM AS EAB_INSERT_DTTM,
    LEFT(RIGHT(EAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS EAB_BUSINESS_DATE,

    ------YTD------
    YDAB.BANK_ID AS YTD_BANK_ID,
    YDAB.ACID AS YTD_ACID,
    YDAB.PREVIOUS_CURRBAL AS PREVIOUS_CURRBAL,
    YDAB.PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL AS PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL,
    YDAB.CURRENT_EOD_DATE AS CURRENT_EOD_DATE,
    YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL AS ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL,
    YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL AS ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL,
    LEFT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 5) AS YTD_BNK_CODE,
    RIGHT(LEFT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 9), 3) AS YTD_SOURCE_CODE,
    YDAB.FILE_NAME AS YTD_FILE_NAME,
    YDAB.INSERT_DTTM AS YTD_INSERT_DTTM,
    LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS YTD_BUSINESS_DATE,
    
    ------CURRENCY CONVERSION------
    EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL AS OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,
    0 AS PREVIOUS_MONTHEND_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE,
    CAST(
        YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(
            DAYOFYEAR,
            CONVERT(
                CHAR(10),
                LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8),
                120
            )
        ) AS DECIMAL(25, 4)
    ) YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL
            ELSE EAB.TRAN_DATE_BAL * BCC.CONVERSIONRATE
        END AS DECIMAL(25, 4)
    ) OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,
    0 AS PREVIOUS_MONTHEND_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP,
    CASE
        WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(
            DAYOFYEAR,
            CONVERT(
                CHAR(10),
                LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8),
                120
            )
        )
        ELSE (
            YDAB.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL / DATEPART(
                DAYOFYEAR,
                CONVERT(CHAR(10), LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8), 120)
            )
        ) * BCC.CONVERSIONRATE
    END YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP,
    DATEPART(
        DAYOFYEAR,
        CONVERT(
            CHAR(10),
            LEFT(RIGHT(YDAB.FILE_NAME, 12), 8),
            120
        )
    ) AS DAY_OF_YEAR,
    CAST(
        CASE
            WHEN GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = 'PHP' THEN 1
            ELSE BCC.CONVERSIONRATE
        END AS DECIMAL(15, 10)
    ) CONVERSION_RATE,
    
    ------OTHER------
    'NA' AS MONTH_YEAR,
    'NA' AS MTD_BANK_ID,
    'NA' AS MTD_SOL_ID,
    'NA' AS MTD_SCHM_CODE,
    'NA' AS MTD_SCHM_TYPE,
    'NA' AS MTD_ACID,
    'NA' AS MTD_FORACID,
    'NA' AS MTD_ACCT_CRNCY_CODE,
    '1900-01-01' AS TRANDATE,
    0 AS AVE_CURR_BALANCE,
    0 AS AVE_CLR_BALANCE,
    0 AS NO_DAYS,
    'NA' AS USERID,
    '1900-01-01' AS MTD_LCHG_TIME,
    'NA' AS QUARTER_YEAR,
    'NA' AS MTD_LAST6_ACC_NUM,
    'NA' AS MTD_BNK_CODE,
    'NA' AS MTD_SOURCE_CODE,
    'NA' AS MTD_FILE_NAME,
    '1900-01-01' AS MTD_INSERT_DTTM,
    @DATEPROCESSED AS AS_OF_DATE,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(
            CASE
                WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y'
                AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= @DATEPROCESSED
                AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA') THEN 'C'
                WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
                AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA') THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
                WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y'
                AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE > @DATEPROCESSED
                AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA') THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
                WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y'
                AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE > @DATEPROCESSED
                AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA') THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
                WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
                AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA') THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
            END,
            ''
        ) = ''
        AND ACCT_OPN_DATE = @DATEPROCESSED THEN 'A'
        ELSE CASE
            WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y'
            AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE <= @DATEPROCESSED
            AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA') THEN 'C'
            WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
            AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA') THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
            WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y'
            AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE > @DATEPROCESSED
            AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('CAA', 'SBA') THEN CASA.ACCT_STATUS
            WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'Y'
            AND GAM.ACCT_CLS_DATE > @DATEPROCESSED
            AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA') THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
            WHEN GAM.ACCT_CLS_FLG = 'N'
            AND GAM.SCHM_TYPE IN ('TDA') THEN TD.ACCT_STATUS
        END
    END AS DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS,
    GAM.FORACID_UNMASKED AS FORACID_UNMASKED
FROM (
        SELECT *
        FROM D360.STG_DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTERFULL
        WHERE H = 'D'
           AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) = @DATEPROCESSED
            --AND CONVERT(DATE, LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) >= CAST(RCRE_TIME AS DATE)
    ) GAM
LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *
        FROM D360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL
        WHERE H = 'D'
            AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) = @DATEPROCESSED 
            --AND CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) >= CAST(RCRE_TIME AS DATE)
            --AND CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) BETWEEN CAST(EOD_DATE AS DATE) AND CAST(END_EOD_DATE AS DATE)
    ) EAB ON GAM.ACID = EAB.ACID
    AND GAM.BANK_ID = EAB.BANK_ID
LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *
        FROM D360.STG_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCESFULL
        WHERE H = 'D'
            AND CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) = @DATEPROCESSED 
            --AND CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) >= CAST(CURRENT_EOD_DATE AS DATE)
    ) YDAB ON GAM.ACID = YDAB.ACID
    AND GAM.BANK_ID = YDAB.BANK_ID
LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT *
        FROM BNKM.CURRENCYCONVERSION
        WHERE CONVERTTOCURRENCYID = 'PHP'
            AND RATEID = 'REV'
            AND CURRENCYCONVERSIONTIMESTAMP = @DATEPROCESSED
    ) BCC ON GAM.BANK_ID = BCC.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
    AND GAM.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE = BCC.CONVERTFROMCURRENCYID
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_CASAMASTER CASA ON GAM.ACID = CASA.ACID
    AND GAM.BANK_ID = CASA.BANK_ID
    AND @DATEPROCESSED BETWEEN CASA.SCD_START_DATE AND CASA.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_TDMASTER TD ON GAM.ACID = TD.ACID
    AND GAM.BANK_ID = TD.BANK_ID
    AND @DATEPROCESSED BETWEEN TD.SCD_START_DATE AND TD.SCD_END_DATE

DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT TOP 1 @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY =FULLDATE
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
WHERE FULLDATE < @DateProcessed
    AND Business_Day_Flag='Y'
    AND FULLDATE=DATEADD(day,1,Previous_Business_Day)
ORDER BY FULLDATE DESC;

    DROP TABLE D360.STG_EDS_DF_YTD_ALL;

CREATE TABLE D360.STG_EDS_DF_YTD_ALL

WITH (
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(GAM_ACID),
    HEAP
)
AS
SELECT DISTINCT FULLDATE,
    PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY,
    BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG,
    DAYOFYEAR,
    LASTDAYOFMONTH,
    DAY, 
    --CASE WHEN MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN DATEDIFF(DAY, FULLDATE, LASTDAYOFMONTH) ELSE 0 END MONTH_END_DIFF,
    DATEDIFF(DAY, FULLDATE, LASTDAYOFMONTH) MONTH_END_DIFF,
    YEAR,
    MONTH,
    CUST_ID,
    GAM_ACID,
    ACCT_CRNCY_CODE,
    GAM_BANK_ID,
    GAM_SCHM_TYPE,
    MONTH_END
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
JOIN D360.STG_EDS_DF_UNION ON 1 = 1 
    --AND SUBSTRING(GAM_SCHM_CODE, 1, 2) <> '09'
    --AND GAM_BANK_ID = 'CBC01'
    AND (
        AS_OF_DATE = @DATEPROCESSED
        OR (
            DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'C'
            AND AS_OF_DATE < @DATEPROCESSED
        )
    )
WHERE FULLDATE BETWEEN @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AND @DATEPROCESSED

    DROP TABLE D360.STG_EDS_DF_MTD_YTD;

CREATE TABLE D360.STG_EDS_DF_MTD_YTD

WITH (
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(GAM_ACID),
    HEAP
)
AS
SELECT TMP.FULLDATE,
    TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY,
    TMP.CUST_ID,
    TMP.GAM_ACID,
    TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE,
    TMP.GAM_BANK_ID,
    TMP.GAM_SCHM_TYPE,
    BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG,
    CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE CB_OB,
    CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE CPB_PB,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0)
            ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0)
        END
    ) AS OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0)
            ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0)
        END
    ) AS OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,
    -- COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,
    -- COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,0) AS PREVIOUS_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = DATEADD(DAY, -1, TMP.FULLDATE) THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0) + COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PHP, 0)
            ELSE SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0)
                    ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0)
                END
            ) OVER(
                PARTITION BY YEAR,
                TMP.GAM_ACID,
                TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
                ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            ) + (
                CASE
                    WHEN YEAR(TMP.FULLDATE) = YEAR(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN COALESCE(DF.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PHP, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
        END
    ) AS TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,
    COALESCE(DF.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PHP, 0) DF_ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PHP,
    DF.AS_OF_DATE DF_AOD,
    -- (
    --     CASE
    --         WHEN YEAR(TMP.FULLDATE) <> YEAR(TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY)
    --         AND CURRENT_PBD.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'C' THEN 0
    --         WHEN CURRENT_PBD.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'C' THEN CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL
    --         ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, 0)
    --     END
    -- ) AS ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL,
    (
        CASE
            WHEN TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = DATEADD(DAY, -1, TMP.FULLDATE) THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0) + COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, 0)
            ELSE SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0)
                    ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0)
                END
            ) OVER(
                PARTITION BY YEAR,
                TMP.GAM_ACID,
                TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
                ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
            ) + (
                CASE
                    WHEN YEAR(TMP.FULLDATE) = YEAR(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN COALESCE(DF.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
        END
    ) AS TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,
    CAST(TMP.DAYOFYEAR AS SMALLINT) DAYOFYEAR,
    LASTDAYOFMONTH,
    CAST(DAY AS SMALLINT) DAY,
    MONTH_END_DIFF, 
    --(
    --		CASE 
    --			WHEN TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP' THEN 
    --				(
    --					(CASE WHEN YEAR(TMP.FULLDATE)<>YEAR(TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY) AND CURRENT_PBD.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS='C' THEN 0 WHEN CURRENT_PBD.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS='C' THEN CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL ELSE  COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL,0) END)
    --					+ (CASE WHEN TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN MONTH_END_DIFF * COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,0) ELSE 0 END)
    --				) / (TMP.DAYOFYEAR + CASE WHEN TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN MONTH_END_DIFF ELSE 0 END)
    --			ELSE COALESCE(DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, CURRENT_BD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) / DAYOFYEAR
    --		END
    --	) AS YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE,
    (
        --		CASE 
        --			WHEN TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP' THEN
        (
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = DATEADD(DAY, -1, TMP.FULLDATE) THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0) + COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, 0)
                    ELSE SUM(
                        CASE
                            WHEN BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0)
                            ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0)
                        END
                    ) OVER(
                        PARTITION BY YEAR,
                        TMP.GAM_ACID,
                        TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
                        ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                    ) + (
                        CASE
                            WHEN YEAR(TMP.FULLDATE) = YEAR(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN COALESCE(DF.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    )
                END
            ) + (
                CASE
                    WHEN TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN MONTH_END_DIFF * COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
        ) / (
            TMP.DAYOFYEAR + CASE
                WHEN TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN MONTH_END_DIFF
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) --			ELSE COALESCE(DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, CURRENT_BD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) / DAYOFYEAR
        --		END
    ) AS YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE,
    (
        --		CASE 
        --			WHEN TMP.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE <> 'PHP' THEN
        (
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = DATEADD(DAY, -1, TMP.FULLDATE) THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0) + COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PHP, 0)
                    ELSE SUM(
                        CASE
                            WHEN BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0)
                            ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0)
                        END
                    ) OVER(
                        PARTITION BY YEAR,
                        TMP.GAM_ACID,
                        TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
                        ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                    ) + (
                        CASE
                            WHEN YEAR(TMP.FULLDATE) = YEAR(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN COALESCE(DF.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_PHP, 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    )
                END
            ) + (
                CASE
                    WHEN TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN MONTH_END_DIFF * COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
        ) / (
            TMP.DAYOFYEAR + CASE
                WHEN TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN MONTH_END_DIFF
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) --			ELSE COALESCE(DEP_YTD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL, CURRENT_BD.ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL) / DAYOFYEAR
        --		END
    ) AS YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP,
    (
        (
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = DATEADD(DAY, -1, TMP.FULLDATE)
                    AND MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE) = MONTH(TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY) THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0) + COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.MTD_AGG_BAL_ORIG_CURR, 0)
                    ELSE SUM(
                        CASE
                            WHEN BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0)
                            ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0)
                        END
                    ) OVER(
                        PARTITION BY YEAR,
                        MONTH,
                        TMP.GAM_ACID,
                        TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
                        ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                    ) + (
                        CASE
                            WHEN MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE) = MONTH(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN COALESCE(DF.MTD_AGG_BAL_ORIG_CURR, 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    )
                END
            ) + (
                CASE
                    WHEN TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN MONTH_END_DIFF * COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
        ) / (
            DAY + CASE
                WHEN TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN MONTH_END_DIFF
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
    ) AS MTD_ADB_ORIG_CURR,
    (
        (
            (
                CASE
                    WHEN TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = DATEADD(DAY, -1, TMP.FULLDATE)
                    AND MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE) = MONTH(TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY) THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0) + COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.MTD_AGG_BAL_PHP, 0)
                    ELSE SUM(
                        CASE
                            WHEN BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0)
                            ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0)
                        END
                    ) OVER(
                        PARTITION BY YEAR,
                        MONTH,
                        TMP.GAM_ACID,
                        TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
                        ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                    ) + (
                        CASE
                            WHEN MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE) = MONTH(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN COALESCE(DF.MTD_AGG_BAL_PHP, 0)
                            ELSE 0
                        END
                    )
                END
            ) + (
                CASE
                    WHEN TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN MONTH_END_DIFF * COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0)
                    ELSE 0
                END
            )
        ) / (
            DAY + CASE
                WHEN TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN MONTH_END_DIFF
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
    ) AS MTD_ADB_PHP,
    (
        (
            CASE
                WHEN TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = DATEADD(DAY, -1, TMP.FULLDATE)
                AND MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE) = MONTH(TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY) THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0) + COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.MTD_AGG_BAL_ORIG_CURR, 0)
                ELSE SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0)
                        ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0)
                    END
                ) OVER(
                    PARTITION BY YEAR,
                    MONTH,
                    TMP.GAM_ACID,
                    TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
                    ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                ) + (
                    CASE
                        WHEN MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE) = MONTH(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN COALESCE(DF.MTD_AGG_BAL_ORIG_CURR, 0)
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                )
            END
        ) + (
            CASE
                WHEN TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN MONTH_END_DIFF * COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
    ) AS MONTHLY_TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE,
    (
        (
            CASE
                WHEN TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = DATEADD(DAY, -1, TMP.FULLDATE)
                AND MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE) = MONTH(TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY) THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0) + COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.MTD_AGG_BAL_PHP, 0)
                ELSE SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'Y' THEN COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0)
                        ELSE COALESCE(CURRENT_PBD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0)
                    END
                ) OVER(
                    PARTITION BY YEAR,
                    MONTH,
                    TMP.GAM_ACID,
                    TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
                    ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
                ) + (
                    CASE
                        WHEN MONTH(TMP.FULLDATE) = MONTH(DF.AS_OF_DATE) THEN COALESCE(DF.MTD_AGG_BAL_PHP, 0)
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                )
            END
        ) + (
            CASE
                WHEN TMP.MONTH_END = 'Y' THEN MONTH_END_DIFF * COALESCE(CURRENT_BD.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 0)
                ELSE 0
            END
        )
    ) AS MONTHLY_TOTAL_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP,
    TMP.MONTH_END,
    CURRENT_BD.DEP_ACCOUNT_STATUS,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY TMP.GAM_ACID,
        TMP.GAM_BANK_ID
        ORDER BY TMP.FULLDATE DESC
    ) RN
FROM D360.STG_EDS_DF_YTD_ALL TMP
LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_DF_BAL_ONLY CURRENT_BD ON TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_BD.GAM_ACID
    AND TMP.FULLDATE = CURRENT_BD.AS_OF_DATE
    AND TMP.GAM_BANK_ID = CURRENT_BD.GAM_BANK_ID
LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_DF_BAL_ONLY CURRENT_PBD ON TMP.GAM_ACID = CURRENT_PBD.GAM_ACID
    AND TMP.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = CURRENT_PBD.AS_OF_DATE
    AND TMP.GAM_BANK_ID = CURRENT_PBD.GAM_BANK_ID
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT DF ON DF.GAM_ACID = TMP.GAM_ACID
    AND DF.AS_OF_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BAL_BDATE
    AND DF.GAM_BANK_ID = TMP.GAM_BANK_ID

DECLARE @SWAP NVARCHAR(MAX);

SELECT @PNS = 1 + COUNT(*)
FROM SYS.PARTITION_RANGE_VALUES PRV
JOIN SYS.PARTITION_FUNCTIONS PF ON PRV.FUNCTION_ID = PF.FUNCTION_ID
JOIN SYS.PARTITION_SCHEMES PS ON PF.FUNCTION_ID = PS.FUNCTION_ID
JOIN SYS.INDEXES I ON I.DATA_SPACE_ID = PS.DATA_SPACE_ID
WHERE I.OBJECT_ID = OBJECT_ID('[D360].[STG_EDS_DF_CURRENT_MONTH]')
    AND I.INDEX_ID < 2
    AND TRY_CAST(PRV.VALUE AS DATE) <= @DATEPROCESSED

SELECT @PNE = 1 + COUNT(*)
FROM SYS.PARTITION_RANGE_VALUES PRV
JOIN SYS.PARTITION_FUNCTIONS PF ON PRV.FUNCTION_ID = PF.FUNCTION_ID
JOIN SYS.PARTITION_SCHEMES PS ON PF.FUNCTION_ID = PS.FUNCTION_ID
JOIN SYS.INDEXES I ON I.DATA_SPACE_ID = PS.DATA_SPACE_ID
WHERE I.OBJECT_ID = OBJECT_ID('[EDS].[DEPOSIT_FACT]')
    AND I.INDEX_ID < 2
    AND TRY_CAST(PRV.VALUE AS DATE) <= @DATEPROCESSED

SET @SWAP = N'
ALTER TABLE [D360].[STG_EDS_DF_CURRENT_MONTH]
SWITCH PARTITION ' + CAST(@PNS AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '
TO [EDS].[DEPOSIT_FACT]
PARTITION ' + CAST(@PNE AS NVARCHAR(10)) + '
WITH (TRUNCATE_TARGET = ON);
';

EXEC SP_EXECUTESQL @SWAP;
